subject: Editing/Modifying the Format of Facet Labels & Panels

messages.author: 2e237531d816f29b
messages.subject: Editing/Modifying the Format of Facet Labels & Panels
parts:
Hi,
Is it possible to edit/modify the general format (i.e., background and text colour, font size and type, etc) of facet panels and their labels when using the facet_plot() function of "ggtree"? For example, this can be done in "ggplot2" when using the facet_wrap() function through specifying "strip" characteristics in theme(), but, at least for me, this approach does not seem to work in "ggtree". Is there another way?
Luke
